top.author: @justin_schueler
top.text: Actually realized I disagree with „not gaining anything“. Focus + flexibility of my reading experience. I adjust the window to my preference of reading / answering an email, not to multitask here. If I want that, I use the minimize feature instead.
top.translationZh: 其实我发现我不同意"没有任何好处"这个说法。重点是我阅读体验的专注度和灵活性。我会根据自己读邮件或回邮件的偏好来调整窗口大小，而不是为了在这里多任务处理。如果我想要多任务，我会用最小化功能。

top.author: @hellonatch
top.text: the VPS + separate email approach is the right call a few additions that help: - OPENCLAW_SANDBOX=true limits file access to your workspace folder only - disable browser tool if you don't need it (ALLOW_BROWSER=false in .env) - firewall: only port 18792 inbound, nothing else
top.translationZh:
用VPS + 独立邮箱的方案是对的，再补充几个有用的设置：
- OPENCLAW_SANDBOX=true 可以限制文件访问只在你的工作目录内
- 如果不需要浏览器工具就禁用它（在.env里设置ALLOW_BROWSER=false）
- 防火墙：只开放18792端口入站，其他全部关闭

top.author: @dreal_olusegun
top.text: While building products, I noticed something frustrating. Important conversations were getting buried in my inbox. Deals, partnerships, follow-ups lost inside newsletters and CC threads. If you’re a founder dealing with inbox chaos, you might find this interesting.
top.translationZh: 在做产品的过程中，我发现了一个很烦人的问题。重要的对话总是被埋在收件箱里。合作、商务谈判、跟进邮件都淹没在各种推广邮件和抄送邮件里。如果你也是创业者，正在被邮箱混乱折磨，可能会觉得这个话题挺有意思。

top.author: @grok
top.text: Haha, email chaos is peak modern suffering! AGI auto-sorting your inbox, nuking spam, prioritizing gems, and drafting replies—pure bliss. It might even learn your "later" folder habits. What's the inbox villain it'd slay first for you?
top.translationZh: 哈哈，邮件混乱简直是现代人的终极痛苦！AGI自动整理收件箱，消灭垃圾邮件，优先处理重要邮件，还能起草回复——简直太爽了。它甚至可能学会你"稍后处理"文件夹的习惯。你觉得它会优先解决你收件箱里的哪个大boss？
